name: HEDISCoreObservationBMI
title: HEDIS Core Observation BMI
description: The HEDIS Core BMI profile extends the HEDIS Core Vital Signs requirements requirements to include requirements for measure calculation.

element.definition: [US Core] Describes what was observed. Sometimes this is called the observation "name".
[US Core] The identification of the code system that defines the meaning of the symbol in the code.
[US Core] A symbol in syntax defined by the system. The symbol may be a predefined code or an expression in a syntax defined by the coding system (e.g. post-coordination).
[US Core] Vital Signs value are typically recorded using the Quantity data type.
element.comment: An observation may have; 1)  a single value here, 2)  both a value and a set of related or component values,  or 3)  only a set of related or component values. If a value is present, the datatype for this element should be determined by Observation.code.  A CodeableConcept with just a text would be used instead of a string if the field was usually coded, or if the type associated with the Observation.code defines a coded value.  For additional guidance, see the [Notes section](http://hl7.org/fhir/observation.html#notes) below.

element.definition: [US Core] The value of the measured amount. The value includes an implicit precision in the presentation of the value.
[US Core] A human-readable form of the unit.

element.short: (USCDI) System that defines coded unit form
element.definition: [US Core] The identification of the system that provides the coded form of the unit.

element.short: (USCDI) Coded responses from the common UCUM units for vital signs value set.
element.definition: [US Core] A computer processable form of the unit in some unit representation system.
